verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms OpenAI serves an llms.txt documentation hub at developers.openai.com (HTTP 200). The speech-to-text guide covering the Whisper/transcription API is itself served as a raw .md page that an agent can fetch directly. The 404 probe was only for a double '.md.md' path and does not undercut this. Missing for 10: confirmation that the llms.txt index specifically links the speech-to-text/Whisper pages, an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs for the open-source openai/whisper repo itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully using these docs.
